Game Overview

In Stick Monkey, the core idea is straightforward: guide a cheeky monkey across perilous gaps using your extendable stick in this vibrant adventure. Master timing and precision with simple controls, ensuring each stick bridges the expanse. Embrace the challenge as gaps widen, providing endless addictive gameplay and captivating graphics for an exhilarating crossing experience.
